signature.name: VTask.pi
signature.type: {I : Type u} -> {f : I → Type u_1} -> {γ : Type u_2} -> [(i : I) → NonAssocSemiring (f i)] -> [NonAssocSemiring γ] -> (g : (i : I) → γ →+* f i) -> γ →+* (i : I) → f i

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.pi is a total construction with no junk-value conventions; it is well-defined for every family of ring homomorphisms, including the vacuous case when I is empty.

facts.statement: ∀ {I : Type*} {f : I → Type*} {γ : Type*} [Nonempty I] [inst1 : ∀ i, NonAssocSemiring (f i)] [inst2 : NonAssocSemiring γ] (g : ∀ i, γ →+* f i), (∀ i, Function.Injective (g i)) → Function.Injective (VTask.pi g)

facts.statement: ∀ {I : Type*} {f : I → Type*} {γ : Type*} [inst1 : ∀ i, Semiring (f i)] [inst2 : Semiring γ] (g : ∀ i, γ →+* f i), RingHom.ker (VTask.pi g) = ⨅ i, RingHom.ker (g i)
